submission.justification: No fully compliant algorithm/threshold combination could be verified from the recorded results because the simulation threshold-performance data are missing and zero candidates have a verified valid threshold. Algorithm-L3 at 20 GeV is submitted only as the least-latency placeholder among candidate algorithms within the allowed threshold range; it satisfies the latency and threshold-range constraints, but its trigger rate and signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz rate are unknown, so the hard 80% efficiency requirement is not verified.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: simulation_threshold_performance_data_available = 0; selected_signal_efficiency_percent = -1; selected_trigger_rate_kHz = -1; no efficiency/rate scan is available to optimize efficiency at 8 kHz.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Submitted option is Algorithm-L3, one of the three listed candidates (Algorithm_L3_ID = 3).

requirements.requirement: The signal efficiency at the allocated rate must be at least 80%.
The algorithm's latency on the Level-1 FPGA hardware must not exceed 4.0 us.

requirements.evidence: Submitted threshold is 20 GeV, matching threshold_min_GeV = 20 and within threshold_max_GeV = 60.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
Trigger rate must be at the allocated trigger rate of 8 kHz or below.
requirements.evidence: allocated_trigger_rate_kHz = 8, but Algorithm_L3_trigger_rate_kHz = -1 and no threshold-performance data are available; final_rate_requirement_pass = 0.
